notes: §1985:VII.4.7.2 prints WRITE record-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ], one optional { BEFORE | AFTER } ADVANCING phrase ({ identifier-2 | integer-1 } [ LINE | LINES ] or { mnemonic-name-1 | PAGE }), then AT { END-OF-PAGE | EOP }, then NOT AT { END-OF-PAGE | EOP }, then [ END-WRITE ], in the sequence §1985:IV.2.1 binds; §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR7: "The phrases ADVANCING PAGE and END-OF-PAGE must not both be specified"; identifier-2 is an identifier, which §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4 keeps from being a numeric or integer function. writeStatement, recordFromPhrase and writeBeforeAfter parse it, BindWrite and BindAdvancing bind it; at 85 VisitConditionalPhrases through OutOfPrintedOrder refuses NOT AT END-OF-PAGE first (COBOL0900, kb/Work PB5158 landed), VisitRecordFromPhrase a FROM literal (COBOL0871), and IntrinsicBinder.ScreenIdentifierPlacement an integer function as identifier-2 (COBOL0900, kb/Work PB5108 landed, the defect this row last named). Re-read 2026-11-15 (registrar landing records-1985-reread): the adjudicator's and refuter's probes of op-20261115/open-rows-1985 re-run on this branch's build (main 2722570af0) at --std 85, logs op-20261115/registrar-1985-reread/log-fmt.txt, log-misc.txt, log-witnesses.txt. At 85: WRITE FROM identifier AFTER ADVANCING identifier LINE AT END-OF-PAGE ... NOT AT END-OF-PAGE ... END-WRITE on a LINAGE IS 3 file prints NOEOP 1, NOEOP 2, EOP 3, NOEOP 4 (work-b/w1); the refuter's 5 accepted shapes (bare WRITE, FROM, BEFORE/AFTER with and without ADVANCING and LINES, ADVANCING PAGE, 0 LINES, a mnemonic-name, FROM an alphanumeric function (Amendment 1 SR1), EOP without AT, EOP, NOT AT EOP alone, a qualified record-name) run; the 18 forbidden forms (FROM literal, PAGE with END-OF-PAGE, a negative or non-integer integer-1, two ADVANCING phrases, ADVANCING after EOP, a non-integer identifier-2, EOP without LINAGE, a mnemonic-name on a LINAGE file, FROM twice, WRITE file-name, INVALID KEY, FROM a numeric function, PAGE LINES, FROM the record itself, ADVANCING without BEFORE/AFTER, EOP with no imperative, AT EOP twice) are refused; the reversed END-OF-PAGE pair and FUNCTION INTEGER (1.5) as identifier-2 refused (COBOL0900). Witnesses at 85: 1985-FMT-VII_4_7_2-end-of-page-pair (accepted; its expected lines derived from §1985:VII.3.7.4 GR1, GR9 and §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR18), 1985-FMT-VII_4_7_2-not-at-end-of-page-first and 1985-FMT-VII_4_7_2-function-advancing-operand (refused COBOL0900), added by this re-read, and 1985-FMT-VII_4_7_2 (ADVANCING without BEFORE or AFTER refused). next.reason: §1985:VII.4.7.2 is 'WRITE record-name-1 [FROM identifier-1]', an optional {BEFORE | AFTER} ADVANCING phrase (one of them), then AT END-OF-PAGE before NOT AT END-OF-PAGE, then [END-WRITE]. Its 2023 counterpart is §2023:14.9.51.2 'Format 1 (sequential)', which §2023:14.9.51.3 SR2 ('If the organization of the write file is sequential, format 1 shall be specified') ties to sequential files; every 1985 WRITE fits it with the same meaning. But BEFORE and AFTER are now in choice indicators, so both may be written, limited only by §2023:14.9.51.3 SR17 ('The BEFORE and AFTER phrases shall not both be specified if the PAGE phrase is specified'); the end-of-page phrases may come in either order; and 'FILE file-name-1', 'FROM literal-1', the retry-phrase and WITH [NO] LOCK are added. All are refused by the 1985 format and accepted by 2023, at compile time: CHANGED.
